title: List / table page
description: A page of records: title with the primary action, a status filter, a searchable, sortable, paginated Table with status tags and row actions, and an empty state

quality.pageHeader: Title and one primary Button in a Row that stacks at s; per-record actions belong in the Table's actions, not the header
quality.cellText: A component cell (name with email, a status Tag) carries its text as children — Table searches and sorts by the text inside each cell
quality.status: Tag with a tone and a text label, never colour alone
quality.emptyState: Offer the way back (clear the filter), not only 'No results'
quality.rowActions: Icon actions with tooltips; destructive ones take tone="danger"
